title: 30kW Hybrid Inverter + 80kWh LiFePO4 Battery in Germany
summary: A 30kW hybrid inverter paired with an 80kWh LiFePO4 battery bank in Germany.
challenge: Hybrid systems are decided by compatibility: the PV array, the battery voltage window, the circuits that stay live during an outage, and the monitoring all have to agree before anything is ordered.
solution: A 30kW hybrid inverter with an 80kWh LiFePO4 bank, configured as one backup-capable system rather than two separate purchases.
